regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrow: only 4 of 17 themes are eligible (Banks, Energy, High-Dividend, Conglomerates), and no single narrative dominates. The absolute-trend gate has proven drawdown-control value here (gate_helps true) and the desk's 29-call track record is strong, but cross-sectional rank has no alpha — this is a risk-discipline lens, not a forecast. All listed themes are unscorable (no ETF proxy), so any lean is graded against heuristic proxies rather than a clean instrument.
emerging_watch: Watch Energy (H-shares) as a potential confirmed handoff from Banks: if Energy's rotation score crosses above Banks' and holds for two consecutive weekly reads while both remain gate-eligible, retire the watch and treat as the new focus; if Banks reclaims a widening margin, retire the watch in the other direction.
